claim.title: SOTA near-isometric shape correspondence
claim.statement: Experimentally testable claim that method outperforms prior axiomatic/supervised/unsupervised baselines on remeshed FAUST/SCAPE/SHREC19. Proposed unsupervised EOT+FM method achieves SOTA near-isometric matching (FAUST/SCAPE/SHREC19).
claim.evidence: p.6-7, Sec.5.1 text plus Table 1 and Fig.2
claim.limitations: Not stated whether gains are statistically significant; limited to mean geodesic error.

objects.text: SOTA near-isometric shape correspondence. Experimentally testable claim that method outperforms prior axiomatic/supervised/unsupervised baselines on remeshed FAUST/SCAPE/SHREC19. Proposed unsupervised EOT+FM method achieves SOTA near-isometric matching (FAUST/SCAPE/SHREC19). Evidence: p.6-7, Sec.5.1 text plus Table 1 and Fig.2 Limitations: Not stated whether gains are statistically significant; limited to mean geodesic error.

objects.label: Table 1
objects.text: Quantitative near-isometric shape matching. Mean geodesic errors for FAUST, SCAPE, SHREC19 under three training regimes. Method outperforms axiomatic, supervised and unsupervised baselines in most near-isometric settings. Evidence: p.7, Table 1 values and caption Limitations: Mean geodesic error only; best/second-best coloring does not give variance or significance.

objects.label: Figure 2
objects.text: Qualitative results on SHREC19 texture transfer. Checker-texture transfer comparison across methods. Method yields better texture transfer on SHREC19 than Deep Shells and ULRSSM. Evidence: p.7, Fig.2 images and caption Limitations: Visual only; subjective and limited to few SHREC19 examples.

project_findings_brief:
- [f1] (deep-shells): Entropy-regularized OT energy integrating squared product-embedding distance enables differentiable Sinkhorn-based shape matching. [evidence: Eq. 8: OT energy integrating squared embedding distance under pi minus entropy regularization enables differentiable Sinkhorn optimization]
- [f2] (deep-shells): Pairwise OT ground cost is explicitly encoded as Gibbs density from negative scaled squared embedding distance. [evidence: Eq. 10 defines p_lambda as exponential of negative scaled squared distance for Sinkhorn input]
- [f3] (deep-shells): A second OT energy using learned feature distance computes initial soft correspondences, exemplifying an alternative ground cost. [evidence: Eq. 13: OT energy using learned feature distance to compute initial pi, showing alternative ground cost in same pipeline]
- [f4] (deep-shells): Product-space embedding of intrinsic eigenfunctions and extrinsic coordinates/normals defines the space where Euclidean distance serves as OT ground cost. [evidence: Eq. 3 embeds shape X into R^{K+6} using intrinsic eigenfunctions plus extrinsic smoothed coordinates and normals whose Euclidean distance becomes ground cost]
